verdict.rationale: FreshBooks' API docs offer a Postman Collection, which is a downloadable, machine-readable description of the API covering its broad REST surface (invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries, reports). A Postman collection is only a partial stand-in for a formal schema spec, and the evidence never mentions an OpenAPI or Swagger file. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger (or equivalent schema-level) spec file, documented download location and versioning of that spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the collection is complete and current.
